$comment: The Cast's hand-written SMS conversations (cast/sms-threads.md, decision 93). Every load writes them. 'number' is a phone number key in configuration/communications.json, and messages are dated back from the install day, oldest first.

threads.name: Jess Hughes
threads.story: Jess asks Ted to pray the night before her youngest son, Jack, has ear tubes put in.

messages.text: Hi Pastor Ted, it's Jess Hughes. Jack gets ear tubes put in early tomorrow morning. I know it's a small thing but I'm a nervous wreck. Would you pray for him?
Of course, Jess. Praying right now for Jack, for steady hands for his doctors, and for peace for you and Matt tonight.
Thank you. That means a lot.
We have to be there at 5:30. I'll text you when he's out.

threads.name: Ana Ramirez
threads.story: Ted follows up after the Ramirez family's second Sunday, and Ana asks how to meet other families.

messages.text: Hi Ana, this is Ted Decker, one of the pastors at Rock Solid. Thanks for filling out a card, and it was great to see your family back on Sunday!
Hi Pastor Ted! Thank you for reaching out. We really liked it. Lucas keeps asking when we can go back.
Is there a good way to meet some other families? We don't really know anyone there yet.

threads.name: Kevin Dawson
threads.story: Ted checks on Kevin after a men's breakfast falls on his weekend with the kids, and offers a weekday coffee instead.

messages.text: Hey Kevin, we missed you at the men's breakfast. No pressure at all. I know some weekends are your time with Tyler and Emma.
Yeah, it was my weekend with them. The breakfasts always seem to land on my weekends.
Totally get it. Those weekends matter. A few of us grab coffee at Javelina Wash Coffee on Tuesday mornings at 6:30, if that ever works better.
That might actually work. I don't start work until 8 on Tuesdays.
Perfect. First cup is on me.
Ha, deal. See you there.

threads.name: Hal Russell
threads.story: Hal thanks Ted for coming along on the monthly communion visit to his home.

messages.text: Pastor Ted, thank you for coming by with the communion team yesterday. It was good to have company and good to pray together.
Hal, it was a gift to sit with you. Thanks for the stories about the church's early days. I'll come back with the team next month.
I'll have the coffee on. God bless you.

threads.name: Josh Sanders
threads.story: Josh asks Ted what to bring to his baptism, then thanks him afterward.

messages.text: Hey Ted, I turned in my baptism form. What do I need to bring on Sunday?
Josh, this is so great! Bring a change of clothes and a towel. We'll have a shirt for you to wear. Plan to get there 30 minutes early.
Got it. Is it OK if my coworker comes to watch? He's the one who first brought me.
Absolutely. Have him sit up front so he can see.
Thanks for Sunday. I'm still smiling.
Me too. Proud of you, Josh. Let's grab lunch soon and talk about what's next.
I'd like that.

threads.name: Mark Fischer
threads.story: Mark asks Isaac to meet with Ethan, who is torn about where to go to college.

messages.text: Hi Isaac, it's Mark Fischer. Ethan is really torn about college, staying close or going out of state. Would you be willing to grab lunch with him sometime?
Hey Mark! I'd love to. He's a great kid. I'll reach out to him and set something up. Praying for all of you in this.
Thank you. Julie and I want him to choose well, not just choose what we want.
He's free after school most days except Thursday.

threads.name: Drew Kim
threads.story: Drew, a college student who grew up in the student ministry, asks Isaac about helping on Wednesday nights.

messages.text: Hey Isaac, it's Drew Kim. Do you need any college students to help out on Wednesday nights?
Drew! Yes, we always need good leaders. You'd need a quick background check and one training night. Want me to send the form?
Yes please. My classes end at 5 on Wednesdays, so I can be there by 6.
Perfect. I'll text you the form tonight.
Filled it out. Thanks!
You're the best. See you at training next week.

threads.name: Ava Brooks
threads.story: Ava asks the student line when her camp form is due and what has to come with it.

messages.text: Hi! This is Ava Brooks. Is the camp form due this Sunday?
Hey Ava! Yes, bring it Sunday or Wednesday night. Don't forget the medical page. It needs a parent signature.
Ok my mom signed it. Do I still need my shot records?
Nope, just the medical page and the signed form. Can't wait to have you back at camp!
Yay thank you!!

threads.name: Jake Sullivan
threads.story: Jake answers the student line's Wednesday night reminder by asking for a ride.

messages.text: Hey Jake! Wednesday night is on this week in the student room. Bring a friend!
can i get a ride? my dad works late on wednesdays
also can my friend come too

threads.name: Michelle Nguyen
threads.story: Michelle, who leads the first-aid team, needs someone to cover her Sunday after she is called in for a shift.

messages.text: Hi Alisha, I just got called in for a shift Sunday morning. Can you help me find someone to cover first aid at the 9:00?
Oh no, sorry Michelle! I'll ask around this morning. Is there anyone on the team you'd like me to try first?
Maybe try the 10:30 folks first? I can take an extra Sunday next month to make up for it.
Thank you so much!

threads.name: Bri Hall
threads.story: Bri needs a ride to her first Starting Point night while her car is in the shop, and Alisha finds her one.

messages.text: Hi, is this Alisha? This is Bri Hall. I signed up for Starting Point tonight.
Hi Bri! Yes, this is Alisha. We're so glad you signed up. What can I do for you?
My car is in the shop until Friday. Is there any way someone from church could give me a ride? I'm in Avondale.
Let me check with a few people. What time are you out of class today?
I'm done at 4:30. It starts at 6:30, right?
Yes, 6:30. Come a few minutes early for coffee if you can.
Good news! Deb Bell from our greeter team can pick you up at 5:30. She drives a white SUV.
Oh that's so kind. Thank you!! Should I send her my address?
I'll give her the address from your card. She'll text you when she's on the way.
She's here! Thank you again.
Have a great night! Find me at the welcome table if you need anything.
Last night was really good. Deb is the sweetest.
She said the same about you! Do you still need a ride next week?
No, I get my car back Friday. But I think I want to be a greeter like Deb.
I love that. I'll let the greeter team know, and we'll get you started.
Yay! Thank you Alisha.

threads.name: Emily Gray
threads.story: Alisha lets Emily know her scheduled gift did not go through because her card expired.

messages.text: Hi Emily, this is Alisha from the church office. Just a heads up, your scheduled gift didn't go through this week. It looks like the card on file expired.
Oh no, thanks for telling me. I have a new card. I'll update it after this run of shifts.
No rush at all. You can update it anytime on the Give page of our website, or I can walk you through it.
Thank you!

threads.name: Helen Evans
threads.story: Helen texts the main line about serving in the children's ministry after a big event on campus, and no one has answered her yet.

messages.text: Hi, my name is Helen Evans. I was at the big event on your campus and asked about helping with the kids ministry. Who should I talk to?
Just checking in on my last message. I'd love to help with the kids if there's a spot.

threads.name: Tiffany Coleman
threads.story: Tiffany asks the main line whether anyone turned in Zoe's water bottle from the preschool room.

messages.text: Hi! Did anyone turn in a purple water bottle from the preschool room on Sunday? It has Zoe's name on the bottom.
Hi Tiffany! Yes, it's in the lost and found by the welcome desk. I'll set it aside with Zoe's name on it.
You're a lifesaver. She's been asking about it all day.

threads.name: Patty Diaz
threads.story: Patty asks the main line for service times before bringing her visiting sister.

messages.text: Good morning. What time are services this Sunday? My sister is visiting and wants to come with us.
Good morning, Patty! Services are at 9:00, 10:30, and noon. We'd love to meet your sister. Kids check-in opens 15 minutes before each one.
Thank you! We'll be at the 10:30.

threads.name: Brandon Watson
threads.story: Brandon replies STOP to a welcome text from the main line, which turns off texting to his phone.

messages.text: Hi Brandon, this is Rock Solid Church. Thanks for being with us on Sunday! Reply anytime if there's something we can help with.
STOP
